summary: All requested deterministic numerical, provenance, preservation, and native execution checks pass. Qualified fixed-training-state diagnostic claims are supported; causal, held-out, current-E1, latency, and target claims are not established.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: All five raw hashes match the accepted predecessor audit; plan/completion/config/raw-CSV links match. The sealed manifest comes from dataset init.txt; train882/dev97/test245 splits are disjoint and the ordered planned train20/stride5 eligible states reconstruct exactly. GT centres/boxes evaluate already-generated candidates and saved executed boxes. Initial template GT and valid-frame selection are explicit. No prediction is substituted for target annotation. Original remote annotation/image bytes and model tensors were not reacquired; their runtime origin remains supported by the predecessor native execution and audit.

B_score_normalization.details: Every one of 31,384 rows reproduces image-clipped executed box, raw IoU, primary IoU, GT-area coverage, and query-minus-primary gain with exact zero error. IoU denominators are geometric unions; coverage uses annotation area. No evaluation denominator uses prediction maxima/minima/means. GT best-of-pool and STOP flooring are explicitly disclosed diagnostic oracles; forced signed gains are also reported.

C_result_existence_and_numbers.details: Native CPU producer rerun and separate independent NumPy checker both exit0 with empty stderr. Rerun report/CSV and independently rebuilt CSV are byte-exact. Every field in 8 scope/bin and 20 per-sequence aggregates matches exactly, including matched realized-count and both-eight subsets for all four variants. All 11 published table rows, paragraph means/counts, and private-table concentration are verified. The prior neural diagnosis is archived COMPLETE/exit0; current E1 progress was not queried or inferred.

D_metric_execution.details: All five producer helpers are called. Actual rerun exercises their outputs; independent stable-score exclusion scanning reconstructs every float32 DEFAULT index/coordinate exactly, with strict radius comparisons and short-list exhaustion, without importing the producer or project neural modules. All default-prefix geometry and raw query action order/ranks/token counts match. Changed-radius/raw-top8 geometric proposals are recomputed from saved scores only; no unexecuted neural IoUs or latency are credited.

E_scope_and_claim_ceiling.details: One seed2027, old full-B primary-only train20 states with fitted preview ad059943: 8,854 trajectory steps, 1,752 stride5 valid states, 239 main-crop-outside states. State-weighted correlated observations are not held-out C20/current-E1 trajectories. Both-eight comparison covers only 1,334/1,752 states (231/239 outside), and the <1-cell outside bin is concentrated 16/5/1 across three sequences. Nominal GT short-side projection is not visible pixels, a CNN information bound, or a causal capacity/identity/occlusion diagnosis. The nearest-centre selection is GT-free, but its outside subgroup is defined using GT and is selected on the predictor geometry. Per-family equal single-query tokens do not make the all-query oracle diagnostic or alternate proposal policies latency-equivalent. No causal benefit, closed-loop upper bound, PR/NPR/SR target attainment, or three-benchmark success follows.

F_evaluation_type.details: Saved DEFAULT-pool query boxes are actual archived neural outputs evaluated against dataset annotation. Alternative candidate geometry, full-grid reachability, GT best-of-pool and STOP are explicitly diagnostic real-GT calculations. Model-produced state trajectories do not turn dataset annotations into synthetic labels. This analysis is not official benchmark evaluation.

limitations: Original remote annotation/image bytes and checkpoint tensors were not independently reloaded; prior provenance is hash-bound and numerical labels independently reproduce.
The actual model/effort route is not attested; semantic assessment is same-family/provisional.
All results concern correlated fixed training states and post-hoc GT oracles. Radius variants have geometry only; no new query encodings or timing.
Both-eight matching excludes 418 all-scope states and 8 outside states. Small outside states are concentrated in three sequences.
The GT-defined outside group selects on location relative to the same crop used by the nearest-centre rule; it cannot identify the causal value of a location prior.
No current E1 progress, PR/NPR/SR target, final benchmark completeness, capacity/visibility/identity cause, or speedup is certified.
next_evidence_required: Retain exact training-state, nominal-size, matched-count, oracle, and token/latency qualifiers when reusing these statistics.

Before promoting a changed proposal/executor policy, execute its actual queries, refresh matching supervision, validate closed-loop held-out performance, and measure complete paired system costs including proposal work.
publication_policy: Only safe aggregate audit MD/JSON are public project outputs. Raw GT, boxes, scores, tables, reconstruction scripts and execution receipts remain private; trace is project-private .aris. No reviewed input was edited.
